findings.note: Unsupported claim about how often the city takes notice: "Plenty of homes hold a lot of belongings and nobody from the city ever looks twice." No ledger claim or source supports it. Remove the sentence, or say only that a full house is not by itself one of the conditions the statute lists.

"Trash, spoiled material or signs of pests are another, and they are the kind of thing the statute talks about." "Spoiled material" is not in clm:1 to clm:4. Prefer the ledger terms: junk, debris, garbage, infestation, combustible waste.

required_actions: Remove or reword the sentence "Plenty of homes hold a lot of belongings and nobody from the city ever looks twice." so it makes no unsupported generalization.

claim_checks.note: Table row 1 matches the ledger wording (among listed conditions that can make a building substandard). Who decides is local enforcement authority, per the brief; no overreach.
Infestation, as determined by a health officer, listed as a condition of inadequate sanitation. Matches.
Lack of adequate garbage and rubbish storage and removal facilities, as determined by a health officer. Matches.
Fire chief or deputy opinion, fire or explosion or ready fuel. Matches.
